provenance: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains rendering parameters and spectral samples only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Sheet-notch metadata follows Ilford Notch Codes Guide; see sheetNotches.source. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer documents and developed-film photographs in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md. The DX edge barcode encodes the DX number cited in edgePrinting.dx.source. Development: ILFORD FP4 PLUS Technical Information (Nov 2018) p3; ILFORD ILFOTEC HC 1+31, 20 C, intermittent agitation. Reference time 8 min from the manufacturer datasheet; its curve was checked against that datasheet's graph (ILFORD FP4 Plus fact sheet, July 2010, p4, ILFOTEC HC 1+31 8 min: max 0.009 D). Development times 6, 9 min are Fotufilm estimates (its process-level rule applied to this film's curve), not manufacturer curves.
